parsed.post: Discarding the latest run (0.9956). Increasing DEPTH to 8 seems to have overshot or requires a different LR. Reverting to my best (0.986129) with DEPTH 8, MATRIX_LR 0.05. Next experiment: I'll try reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to see if a more stable descent helps the deeper model converge better within the 5-min budget.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.03 to improve stability/convergence for the deeper (DEPTH 8) model.
